description: Reads a URL with its read_page tool rather than guessing.

turns.prompt: This is an automated test. Read https://example.com and tell me the page's main heading, exactly as written.
turns.message:
The page (example.com) has no heading element at all — no `<h1>`. What it does have:

- **Title:** `Example Domain`
- **Body text (the only paragraph):** `This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. This is not a service; avoid relying on it for testing and monitoring purposes.`

So if you mean the document title, it's **Example Domain**; if you mean an on-page heading, there isn't one in the current markup.
